headline: As of 2026-10-18: 8,963,056 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 8,963,056 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,308,140), Georgia (837,439), Florida (833,480).
